sections.title: Introductory Organismal Biology Lab
sections.description: An intense lab course focused on organismal diversity, ecology, and physiology. Students will gain an understanding and appreciation of organisms from prokaryotes to eukaryotic vertebrates. Labs involve microscopy and in depth physiology experiments.
